parameter_status: Exploratory pre-registration; decay and scenario impacts not historically fitted or calibrated. No parameter selection based on the four live weeks.
update_rule: Fixed decay; EWMA updates only after observed open sessions. Residual window rolls automatically; recursive daily variance also updates within simulated paths. No weekly manual sigma override.
direction_rule: Zero conditional log-return drift for equities and zero yield-change drift. Output arithmetic mean/median of simple-return draws; neither is manually forced to zero.
overlay_rule: Categorical mutually exclusive weekly overlays; each non-none weight <=20%, sum all weights=1. Fixed additive percentage-point/bp impacts. These weights are subjective, not calibrated event probabilities.
primary_score: weighted_interval_score=sum(alpha/2*IS_alpha)/sum(alpha/2), alpha in [0.5,0.2,0.1]. Interval-only proper weighted score for fair legacy comparison; never substitute legacy mean for missing median.
full_wis: New versions additionally record (0.5*absolute_median_error+sum(alpha/2*IS_alpha))/3.5; not compared with legacy absent a frozen median.
calendar_rule: Core three US series only. Complete weekday grid with explicit audited open flags. Null required on closed days, no variance update. Historical five-day blocks must have an open observation wherever the target mask is open; mask out target closed sessions, minimum20 compatible blocks. Reference/target use each market's explicitly dated last open session of the corresponding week; never label a Thursday quote as a Friday observation. Existing controls must match actual reference and target sessions.
promotion_rule: At 26 admitted consecutive complete on-time real weekly cohorts only: >=10% normalized primary-score improvement, >=2/3 assets improve, no asset WIS or center MAE >10% worse, aggregate tail pinball improves, approximate paired 4-week moving-block bootstrap 95% upper bound <0. Must pass against legacy hybrid and dynamic Gaussian; LLM version must additionally beat no-LLM FHS. Review only, never auto-promote. If inconclusive, no repeated weekly testing; register a later checkpoint separately.
